purpose: Publishable ClearML connection declaration read by ehr_evidence_app.tracking.connection. It records the user-authorised hosted endpoints, workspace and project, and names the process-local environment variable that points the SDK at the existing untracked configuration file. It holds no local path, account, key or configuration content.
notes: Only this repository's config directory may supply this file.

This declaration satisfies the Step 9 authorization gate (user_approved_step_10_configuration) for connection checks only; config/clearml_policy.json still governs which payload categories may ever reach the tracker.
The configuration file stays at its existing untracked location and is named only through CLEARML_CONFIG_FILE in the probe process; its path is never recorded here.
No general tracking, lineage record, hyperparameter upload or model artefact upload is enabled by this declaration.

synthetic_task.comment: SYNTHETIC Step 10 connection check. Metadata only; no patient, protected, prompt, response, attribution, model or data content.
